requirements.quote: Sub-requirement 4: The power module circuit must be able to track the Lithium-Ion battery level and communicated this through an I2C interface.
requirements.text: The power module must track battery level and communicate via I2C.

requirements.quote: Sub-requirement 5: The power supply module must incorporate a battery charger capability that will charge the battery when the input power is from the 5V DC source.
requirements.text: The power supply must charge the battery using a 5V DC input.

requirements.quote: Description: The power supply module must be supplied with documentation.
requirements.text: The power supply module must include documentation.

requirements.quote: Sub-requirement 1: The power supply module shall contain datasheets for all components including the battery, PCB binary files, and schematic circuit diagrams.
requirements.text: The module must include datasheets, PCB files, and schematics.

requirements.quote: Description: Perform the following system acceptance tests to the expected results as outlined in table 1 below.
requirements.text: Perform system acceptance tests as per Table 1.

requirements.quote: Sub-requirement 1: Test report outlining the test cases outcome results.
requirements.text: Provide a test report with test case outcomes.

requirements.quote: a) The Device must power ON when only the Battery is connected to the power supply module.
requirements.text: The device must power on with only the battery connected.

requirements.quote: b) The Device must power ON when the DC source is connected to the power supply module.
requirements.text: The device must power on with the DC source connected.

requirements.quote: c) The power supply module must be able to charge the battery while powering the Device from the DC source.
requirements.text: The module must charge the battery while powering the device.
